stage: Development review after the initial synthetic action checker passed and before the final reader demonstration was sealed
unchanged_selection: All 384 factorial edits, six task flips, twelve pipeline-contract rejections and the equal-score/different-target control in ACTION_CHECK_PLAN.json remain selected.
reason: Use distinct fields for a change of task type, a new finite observed effect, and a change of predicted quantity. The initial API used 'task declaration' for all three, which obscured these differences.

final_semantics.requires_task_declaration: True only when task changes between treated_state and reference_effect
final_semantics.requires_reference_record_update: True when an active Cpred or Cobs declaration changes
final_semantics.requires_prediction_definition_update: True for a task switch, an active Cpred change, or an active native-effect state-lift change
final_semantics.native_state_lift_scope: new_prediction_state; the observed treated target remains Y
final_semantics.observation_reference_scope: new_observed_realization; the task type remains reference_effect
final_semantics.simultaneous_edits: Separate change_flags retain every active change even when comparison_scope reports only its highest-priority label
final_semantics.prediction_shape: Predictions and residuals have fits-by-genes shape; scores have fits-by-metrics shape; observed targets are gene vectors

additional_validation: Reject a nonfinite candidate collection instead of silently treating an undefined candidate distance as a retrieval failure.
interpretation: This is an API semantics refinement and a finite-input validation fix. It does not change datasets, metric formulas, intervention cases, score thresholds or outcome selection.
